description: The programme list identifies regulated organisations and facilities receiving emissions-compliance cost-containment support under TIER and its earlier CCIR regime. Source descriptions distinguish added credit-use flexibility from extra benchmark allocations. The single XLSX descriptor covers 2018–2022. This resource describes facility-specific regulatory treatment and economic constraints, not measured emissions or support amounts. The abstract says designated facilities may satisfy 100%of an annual obligation through credits when flexibility relief applies; current programme rules are not independently checked. Exact facility identifiers and numerical allocations are not stated in the inspected metadata. The Canadian Urban Data Catalogue preserves the source title, description and original Alberta identifiers. The record labels the material Open Government Licence - Alberta. Costs, current file access and numerical contents are unverified. No linked document, workbook, archive, installer or data body was fetched. Specific simulation uses remain unstated unless described above.
